component.name: Clone Studio
component.summary: Move everything to your new Linux computer

description.p: Clone Studio migrates files, apps, settings, SSH keys and desktop configuration from an old Linux computer to a new one, over Wi-Fi, a direct network cable or a USB drive. Nothing ever touches the internet.

ul.li: A beginner-proof wizard, run on both computers
TLS-encrypted transfers with a 6-digit pairing code bound to the connection
Journaled, resumable transfers that never overwrite files already on the new computer
